title: The New York Times Is Running for Reporting
summary: The Times is helping support a new generation of journalists by raising money for the Craig Newmark Graduate School of Journalism’s free tuition at the New York City Marathon.
body_markdown:
The Times is helping support a new generation of journalists by raising money for the Craig Newmark Graduate School of Journalism’s free tuition campaign at the N.Y.C. Marathon.


The Times is marking its 175th anniversary by supporting the journalism industry — raising awareness for the need for more reporting nationwide and cultivating the next generation of reporters.


“Reporting is at the core of everything we do at The New York Times. Training the next generation of journalists is critical to that mission,” said C.E.O. Meredith Kopit Levien. “To celebrate the 175th anniversary of The Times, and along with our Run for Reporting team, I’m excited to hit the pavement for the N.Y.C. Marathon this November and raise funds for the free tuition campaign at CUNY’s Craig Newmark Graduate School of Journalism.”


You can donate to the CUNY J-School Free Tuition campaign


[here](https://onecau.se/_m9pb51) .


Interested in running for reporting? Join our[Strava Run for Reporting Run Club](https://www.strava.com/clubs/runforreporting) and run in support of CUNY or the journalistic nonprofit of your choice.


The run club aims to bring universities, educators, early-career reporters and veteran journalists together. It is an open, virtual community where people across the country can log miles, connect with peers and run in solidarity with the future of independent reporting.
